target_identification.speaker: Unnamed first-person narrator
target_identification.anchor_quote:
Saavist som jeg altid hellere har sagt Dig for lidt
end for meget, saavist elsker jeg Dig. Jeg elsker Dig i Lyst og i
Nød, Hverdage og Festdage. Du er den, jeg vil dø med, men først vil
jeg leve meget, meget længe med Dig. Javel har jeg længtes efter
min yndige Elskerindes Kærtegn. Men mest har jeg længtes efter alt
det andet, som ogsaa er Dig: dit trofaste Hjærte, din rene Tanke,
din milde Tale, dit lyse Smil, som er min Sol i Tvivlen, dit gode
Haandtryk, som er min Styrke paa Vejen.

original_speech_situation: At their reunion, Maria asks whether the narrator's apparent love is genuine, enduring, and not merely a temporary product of longing. He answers her directly with the focal avowal, framed as an emphatic assurance.
undertaking_and_uptake: The focal words themselves undertake no specific action. The surrounding turn separately presents enduring companionship and living together, but those commitments are not part of the exact target. Maria's crying from happiness and her represented understanding that he speaks truth show that she receives the larger answer as sincere reassurance; the scene does not separately record formal acceptance of any undertaking within the focal words.
